subject: Onboarding additional governance & procurement stakeholders — need extended demo window
messages:
From: Ariana Cole <ariana.cole@atlashealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Liao <ben.liao@atlashealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Atlas Health demo — scheduling and additional stakeholders

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for lining up the demo. A quick update from our side: we just looped in our security lead (Ben Liao) and procurement (Sofia Ramos). They both need to attend the run-through to sign off on the integration and contract terms.

Because of that, we need a longer session (about 75–90 minutes) to get into governance, data flow, and procurement questions. Also, a couple of folks on our team will be traveling next week (Mar 6–10), so the earliest practical window for everyone is the week of Mar 13.

Can you propose 2–3 slots that work for your side? Preferably afternoons PT, but we can be flexible on the east coast.

Attaching a short attendees list and their roles.

Attachment: atlas-attendees.pdf (application/pdf)

Thanks —
Ariana
Operations Director
Atlas Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ariana Cole <ariana.cole@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Liao <ben.liao@atlashealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Health demo — scheduling and additional stakeholders

Hi Ariana — great to hear the governance and procurement leads will join. Totally makes sense to expand the agenda.

We can extend to a 90-minute session and will add a focused governance + procurement block so Ben and Sofia see the end-to-end controls and contract touchpoints. Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Mar 14, 11:00–12:30
- Wed Mar 15, 14:00–15:30
- Thu Mar 16, 15:00–16:30

If any of those work, we’ll send a calendar invite and a slightly expanded agenda. I’m looping in Karthik (solutions) and Vivek (platform/infrastructure) so we have the right technical voices. Karthik — can you prepare a one-page infra checklist and Vivek, can you add an estimated timeline slide to the deck?

Attaching a draft agenda for the 90-minute run (agenda includes governance, infra, demo, Q&A, procurement next steps).

Attachment: Redwood_Demo_Agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-03-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Health demo — scheduling and additional stakeholders

Thanks — quick technical note from our side: to make the governance conversation productive I’ll attach a short infra checklist and a brief pre-read that covers access controls, data residency options, and audit logging. If your security team can glance at the pre-read before the meeting, we can spend more time on architecture decisions instead of clarifying basics.

Also, one small ask: if procurement wants to discuss contracting options (reserve capacity vs. pay-as-you-go) we should keep a 15–20 minute slot toward the end; otherwise contracting threads tend to spill into follow-ups.

Pre-read attached. For slots, Mar 15 14:00–15:30 PT looks best for our infra SMEs — happy to hold the other times if needed.

Attachment: infra-checklist.txt (text/plain)

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect

Hi Marissa/Karthik —

Thanks, that all sounds good. Confirming Mar 15, 14:00–15:30 PT works for the group. I’ve added our procurement lead, Jillian Park, to the thread as she’ll cover contracting. Please send a calendar invite (90 minutes) and include the agenda + deck. If you can add the infra checklist to the invite or Drive link that would be great.

We’ll plan for: governance (30m), infra/arch (30m), procurement/questions (30m).

Attachment: attendees-final.pdf (application/pdf)

See you then —
Ariana
Operations Director
Atlas Health
